evidenceClass: Preparation and synthetic mocked HTTP guard tests only; no live Auth, Storage or database request executed.

livePath.login: Normal email/password Auth only from the ignored file; publishable API key only.
livePath.identity: GET /auth/v1/user verifies exact existing known-object owner or distinct user; RPC is_tracker_member must return true for owner and false for other.
livePath.controls: Owner must first read the exact known manual/extraction rows and match both original image byte sizes and SHA256 hashes. Other-user REST must return actual 200 empty row-filter results; Storage must return a recognized object/access denial. Gateway/JWT failures, arbitrary HTTP errors or missing owner controls do not pass.
livePath.cleanup: Finally POST /auth/v1/logout?scope=local for only each session returned by this checker, even after policy/identity/body failure. Never global/others/admin logout, refresh, browser credential extraction or user creation.
livePath.reports: Each explicit live run writes a new immutable sanitized timestamped report; no emails/passwords/tokens/object paths/user metadata/row bodies are saved.

remainingAccessRequirements: Owner must enter existing owner email/password directly into the private file; no credentials in chat.

A genuinely distinct existing Supabase Auth email/password user, not a tracker member, is required. The most recent recorded hosted audit had one Auth user; a second account is not established. This script does not create users or change membership/passwords.
After configuration and explicit live execution, owner body/REST and signed-nonmember denials remain unverified until the real requests succeed.
If MFA or another Auth policy prevents a plain password session, fail closed and report that requirement; do not bypass it.
limitations: Mock tests do not establish hosted access-policy behavior.
Local logout revokes the created refresh session; already-issued access JWTs can remain valid until expiration. Tokens are discarded, never persisted.
The check reads two previously uploaded synthetic original objects and two known owner rows, not all private data or application cookie-session routes.
Owner browser download, phone layout, backup restoration, independent session contention and human holdout acceptance remain separate checks.
